findings.explanation: The SPL has no time-window logic and does not use bookingStart or bookingEnd in any comparison; a workspace with any booking counts as booked for every occupancy event.
findings.quote: Define ghost booking as: room booked but no occupancy detected within 10 minutes of booking start.
findings.suggested_fix: Describe the time-overlap correlation the reader must build, or reword to match what the SPL does.

findings.explanation: These conditions are true for nearly every row and are not a ghost-booking alert; the SPL is a utilization report and has no alert condition. The control test repeats the same conditions.
findings.suggested_fix: State that the result is a per-workspace summary with ghost_rate, walk-ins and average fill, and name a ghost_rate threshold if alerting is wanted.

findings.explanation: The SPL reads cisco:spaces:workspace and webex:workspace_bookings; Webex RoomAnalytics people counts and calendar feeds are never searched, and neither sourcetype is named or confirmed. Verify the Spaces and Webex add-on sourcetypes and fields (peopleCount, roomCapacity, bookingStart).
findings.quote: Cisco Spaces occupancy data, Webex device people count (RoomAnalytics), calendar/booking system data
findings.suggested_fix: Name the exact sourcetypes and fields the searches use and where each comes from.

findings.explanation: The Webex add-on is described as a GitHub source and tagged with a github equipment entry; check whether it is a Splunkbase app and give its Splunkbase ID. The Meraki add-on 5580 is listed but supplies no data used here.
findings.suggested_fix: Give the verified Splunkbase name and ID for the Webex add-on and drop the Meraki add-on unless it is used.

findings.explanation: The SPL aggregates over the whole window by workspace, so there is no time-slot dimension; also Step 3 says 'Compare with the BMS console for the same equipment, sensors, and time range', which does not fit booking data.
findings.quote: Heat map (utilization by room and time slot)
findings.suggested_fix: Add a time bucket to the search or drop the time-slot heat map; validate against the booking system.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: join type=left on workspaceId has no time condition, so booked becomes true for any event of a booked workspace and sum(booked) counts joined rows, not bookings. ghost_booking and walk_ins are therefore unreliable.

summary: A clear ghost-booking idea, but the SPL joins bookings to occupancy by workspace only, so the 10-minute ghost-booking rule in the implementation is not implemented. Data sources, app list and description do not match the search.
